kpis.description_fr: Revenus générés par les services vidéo dans le segment Residential Connectivity & Platforms, reflétant l'érosion continue des abonnés câble traditionnels.
kpis.description_en: Revenue from video services in the Residential Connectivity & Platforms segment, reflecting ongoing traditional cable subscriber erosion.
kpis._specific_to: Segment-level product line revenue for video, core cable TV metric

kpis.description_fr: Revenus totaux du segment Parcs à Thème (Universal Studios Orlando, Hollywood, Osaka, Beijing), incluant billetterie et dépenses in-park.
kpis.description_en: Total revenue from the Theme Parks segment including Universal Studios locations, ticket sales and in-park spending.
kpis._specific_to: Distinct operating segment revenue for theme park business

kpis.description_fr: Revenus du segment connectivité B2B couvrant les PME et grandes entreprises (haut débit, voix, réseau ethernet, SD-WAN).
kpis.description_en: Revenue from the Business Services Connectivity segment covering SMB and enterprise customers with broadband, voice and network services.
kpis._specific_to: B2B connectivity segment, distinct from residential, key growth driver

kpis.description_fr: Revenus publicitaires domestiques du segment Média (NBC, Peacock, chaînes câble), indicateur clé de l'audience et de la monétisation publicitaire.
kpis.description_en: Domestic advertising revenue within the Media segment across NBC, Peacock and cable networks, a key audience monetization metric.
kpis._specific_to: Sub-segment advertising revenue line within Media, reflects TV/streaming ad market exposure

kpis.description_fr: Revenus de connectivité internationale (principalement Sky UK et Italie), reflétant la croissance des abonnés haut débit hors États-Unis.
kpis.description_en: International connectivity revenue primarily from Sky UK and Italy, reflecting broadband subscriber growth outside the United States.
kpis._specific_to: Geographic/product sub-line within Residential Connectivity, distinct from domestic broadband

kpis_story.description_fr: Annoncé Nov 2024 : spinoff cable networks (MSNBC, CNBC, USA Network, Golf Channel, E!, Oxygen, SyFy) en Versant. Closing 2025. CMCSA refocus broadband + Peacock + parks.
kpis_story.description_en: Nov 2024 announced: spinoff of cable networks (MSNBC, CNBC, USA Network, Golf Channel, E!, Oxygen, SyFy) into Versant. 2025 closing. CMCSA refocuses broadband + Peacock + parks.
